'''Gil''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As a member of [[Clan Varad]], he participated in the [[Battle for the Allusis|Battle for the ''Allusis'']]. He fought the strike team&mdash;sent to capture the hijacked ship&mdash;on the ship's [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], only to be defeated and killed.<ref name="Mandalorian Raiders" />
